# Scene reset checklist (per trial)

Session id: ______  Trial id / planned condition: ______  Operator: ______  Date: ______

Before the trial starts (tick each; time the whole reset with a stopwatch and log it in `reset-time-log.csv`):

- [ ] Physical e-stop/power cut within reach; area clear of people
- [ ] Robot in the home pose, no error shown
- [ ] Block on the start mark (position matches the condition; for `object_position` use the specified offset)
- [ ] Target region clear, boundary visible
- [ ] Nothing else in the workspace; cables clear of the arm
- [ ] Lighting/background/occlusion set to the condition (note it)
- [ ] Camera framing checked; recording shows block and target
- [ ] Previous trial's files saved; new trial id selected
- [ ] Hands out of the workspace before starting

After the trial:

- [ ] Note any touch of the block or scene during the trial (assisted)
- [ ] Note anything unusual (slip, noise, camera glitch) in the trial notes
- [ ] Reset time recorded (seconds): ______
